title: 第二十三章 野怪五五开第二十四章 缝缝补补
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 脑内的时间流速好像慢了下来，看着百米内越来越亮的点点灵光解清玄有些绝望。
事已至此她好像是真没辙了……
难道只能下个世界见了么……
解清玄颤抖的睫毛缓缓降下，就要遮住那恍惚的瞳孔。
可她若是死了真的还能有第二次穿越的机会吗？
兴许，这一次闭眼便真的什么都没了啊……
解清玄垂死病中惊坐起！
不能够啊！
眼前这凤雕是什么？是原著中连提都没提到过的小野怪啊！
她这行为相当于什么？相当于开着个高等级高装备的账号死在路边野怪手上啊！
太tmd憋屈了！太给穿越者丢脸了！
不甘心，她的冒险才刚刚开始啊！她不甘心自己就这么悄无声息地死在这鸟不拉屎的地方！
这种死法还不如原著里那样，“风风光光”“轰轰烈烈”地死在气运之子的男主手下，好歹还能在这个世界留下点痕迹！
拼了啊！兄弟萌！
“我不能就此倒下！”
喊了句极其中二的台词为自己壮胆，解清玄一咬牙破开了自己的灵根。
伴随着剧烈的疼痛和灵魂上的颤抖，灵根中被压缩到极致的浓烈灵气瞬间爆发，解清玄极力维持着岌岌可危的精神将那磅礴的灵力全全灌注进手中银剑！
这相当于自断仙路的法子常人一生只能使用一次，是她从书中男主段莫弃那学来的。
对，他对付那散修用的就是这招。但他用完了能偶得【水玉魂】和他【藤木之晶】修复灵根，但她解渃尘手上没有其中任何一样，她用这招是真真的下定决心梭哈赌命了！
还有筹码去赌，总比坐以待毙的强。
凤雕的爪子再次落下，周身灵光也终于化作风刃迸发！
解清玄没有躲避，只是死命攥住手中如炎阳一般耀眼炽热的长剑向它刺去！
殊死一击不是你死就是我活！
出剑似乎还是慢了半瞬……
剑上灵光击碎了漫天风刃，但凤雕的利爪还是率先割开了解清玄的肩膀，力道之大几乎将她一分为二！可她剑势未停，依旧用残躯顶着凤雕的爪子，使剑锋深入凤雕的腹部！
剑柄拖拽。
率先被破开的还是凤雕的肚子！
凤雕立马脱力瘫软，它吃痛发出嘶鸣想挣扎着再次聚力站起，但如此情形之下只能徒劳地喷洒鲜血以及没有肌腱兜底的内脏。
解清玄的状态也没好到哪去，她上半身就像要有丝分裂了似的！
content_en:
The flow of time in his mind seemed to slow down, and Jie Qingxuan felt a little desperate as he watched the brighter and brighter spiritual lights within a hundred meters.
At this point, she seemed to be at her wits end...
Could it be that we can only meet in the next world...
Jie Qingxuan's trembling eyelashes slowly lowered, trying to cover his dazed pupils.
But if she dies, will she really have a second chance to travel through time?
Maybe, if you close your eyes this time, there will really be nothing...
…
Xie Qingxuan sat up in shock while he was dying!
It can't be!
What is this phoenix sculpture in front of me? It's a little wild monster that wasn't even mentioned in the original work!
What does her behavior amount to? It's equivalent to driving a high-level and high-equipment account and dying at the hands of wild monsters on the roadside!
It’s so frustrating! What an embarrassment to the time-travelers!
Not willing to give in, her adventure has just begun! She was unwilling to die quietly in this inhospitable place!
This way of death is not as good as in the original work, where he died "gloriously" and "robustly" at the hands of the hero of Son of Destiny. At least he could leave some traces in this world!
Work hard! Brother cute!
"I can't just fall down!"
After shouting an extremely good line to embolden himself, Xie Qingxuan gritted his teeth and opened his spiritual roots.
Accompanied by severe pain and trembling in his soul, the strong spiritual energy compressed to the extreme in his spiritual roots exploded instantly. Xie Qingxuan tried his best to maintain his precarious spirit and poured all the majestic spiritual power into the silver sword in his hand!
This is equivalent to a method that can only be used once in a lifetime to cut off the path to immortality. She learned it from Duan Mo Qina, the male protagonist in the book.
Yes, this was the trick he used to deal with the casual cultivator. But when he ran out, he could occasionally get the [Water Jade Soul] and his [Wine and Wood Crystal] to repair his spiritual roots, but she didn't have any of them in Jie Luchen's hands. She was really determined to gamble her life with this move!
It's better to gamble if you still have chips than to sit back and wait for death.
The phoenix eagle's claws fell again, and the aura around him finally turned into wind blades and burst out!
Xie Qingxuan didn't dodge, he just grabbed the long sword in his hand that was as dazzling as the sun and stabbed at it!
A fatal blow means either you die or I live!
The sword seemed to be drawn out a moment too late...
The aura on the sword shattered the sky-wide wind blades, but the Phoenix Eagle's sharp claws were the first to cut through Xie Qingxuan's shoulder, with such force that it almost split her into two! But her sword power did not stop, and she still pressed the phoenix eagle's claws with her remaining body, making the sword edge penetrate deep into the phoenix eagle's abdomen!
The hilt dragged.
The first thing to be broken open was the Phoenix Eagle's belly!
The phoenix eagle immediately lost all strength and became limp. It screamed in pain and tried to gather its strength to stand up again, but in this situation it could only spray blood and internal organs without tendons in vain.
Xie Qingxuan's condition wasn't much better, her upper body seemed to be undergoing mitosis!
